title: Back navigation
guidance: Use one quiet page-level return at a consistent top-left position. Increase legibility on wide desktop displays without making it compete with the task. Remove redundant return buttons in cards.

decisions.title: One quiet return in the top-left page lead-in
decisions.reason: Detail, recovery and unavailable screens keep the same return position. Remove duplicate loud return buttons when the top-left return already supplies the route.

decisions.title: Readable on large displays
decisions.reason: The label uses 1rem and inherits bounded viewport scale plus explicit text enlargement. Sign-in/role recovery returns to the workspace instead of exposing a private list.

decisions.title: One return atom, including card examples
decisions.reason: backLink always emits cu-back-link; inside is metadata only. Useful forward navigation uses an action variant rather than a return-link styling exception.

parameters.name: Back link
parameters.description: 1rem label,1.125em chevron, comfortable hit area and visible focus.

parameters.name: Page spacing
parameters.description: Use the existing page-return/page-back wrapper; let long labels wrap intrinsically.
